trapFamily.trap: vendor shape in the port: the geocoding vendor's request, result, match precisions, address components and error class leak into the port and the delivery-scheduling service

subGoals.rule: Ports and the application core speak the application's own language; the geocoding vendor's request, result, field names and precision codes stay in the adapter (Cockburn P1: each adapter talks to the application through a port).
The core has no runtime dependency on the vendor SDK: a geocoder outage reaches it as its own error (Cockburn P1).

precedent: clean-shaped: the existing pickup-point port (application/ports/out/PickupPoints.ts) is written in the application's own types (PickupPoint, GeoPoint) and the Geopin pickup-points adapter translates to the SDK's places request and back from its placeId / displayName / location.lat / location.lng.
